knowledge_before_implementation: All primary empirical outer contrast envelopes included zero; the joint formula was already derived. No empirical joint outcomes were inspected.

api.required_shared_input: One roster and one per-row probability interval at the same evaluation time

optimization.fixed_rows: Aggregate interval endpoint sums and selected counts for rows with one allowed state.
optimization.variable_reduction: Subtract minimum per-row early and late counts; the DP tracks only remaining increments.
optimization.feasibility: Boolean cardinality DP returns every reachable positive later count pair.
optimization.cost: For each count pair, additive min/max DP over all permitted row states; add fixed-row contribution and take global extrema.
optimization.batching: Candidate count pairs form the leading NumPy dimension; batches change storage only.
optimization.scope: Sharp infimum/supremum for the closed common-probability interval/nesting relaxation, within floating-point tolerance; still an outer bound for full biological tree completions.

boundary_handling.zero_upper: Only state00 is allowed; known selected status is inconsistent.
boundary_handling.known_status_contradiction: Raise ValueError when no allowed nested state remains.
boundary_handling.zero_denominator_possible: True exactly when each row permits some state with late=0.
boundary_handling.selected_zero_lower: Use closure infimum; do not claim a selected finite family has zero true path probability.
boundary_handling.endpoint_compatibility: Caller responsibility because the API receives no evaluation or horizon times.
zero_contrast_shortcuts: All feasible count pairs have N1=N2
Only one row can be selected
All potentially selected rows have the same fixed probability

resource_policy.covers: Estimated NumPy DP arrays and feasibility/cost operation counts; not total process memory or Python input/metadata.
resource_policy.failure: MemoryError or RuntimeError; no source case or count pair silently omitted.

pre_empirical_revision.change: Added feasibility-DP work guard before allocating/iterating large generic cases and included that work in diagnostics. Selection states, formulas and cost optimization unchanged.

limitations: Not a sampling confidence interval or population branching-law test
Still omits full-tree and cross-time compatibility constraints
Input source identities, masks and endpoint statuses remain assumptions
A post-primary-results refinement, not a blinded empirical test
